stories.description: The talk is a direct challenge to a position Telegram took in March. Trend Micro's Zero Day Initiative (ZDI) had reported a bug in the app's sticker code.

stories.description: Google will let approved third-party Android stores offer one-tap installs and background updates outside the US, subject to malware scanning.
